preprocessing.mango: Savitzky-Golay 2nd derivative, window 13, poly 2, wavelengths 684-990 nm
preprocessing.ossl: log10(1/R) at 10 nm steps 400-2500 nm, Savitzky-Golay 1st derivative, window 11; target log(1+OC)

pls.selection: min group-balanced RMSE of out-of-group cross-validation

wcp.density_ratio: logistic regression on standardised PLS scores and log Q

note: Values here document the settings hard-coded in src/ (tasks.py, methods.py); they are the single source used by the paper.

cnn.architecture: Conv1d(1->8, kernel 9, same padding) - ELU - Flatten - Linear(64) - ELU - Linear(32) - ELU - Linear(1)
cnn.epochs: max 40, early stopping patience 8 on a 10 % unit-grouped internal validation split

wcp_clip.weights: density ratios normalised to mean 1 on the calibration set and capped at 20
